cards.front: What is the derivative of sin(x)?
cards.back: cos(x) - the derivative of sine is cosine

cards.front: What is the derivative of cos(x)?
cards.back: -sin(x) - the derivative of cosine is negative sine

cards.front: What is the integral of 1/x?
cards.back: ln|x| + C - the integral of 1/x is the natural logarithm of the absolute value of x

cards.front: What is the chain rule for derivatives?
cards.back: If y = f(g(x)), then dy/dx = f'(g(x)) × g'(x)

cards.front: What is the product rule for derivatives?
cards.back: If y = u × v, then dy/dx = u(dv/dx) + v(du/dx)

cards.front: What is the quotient rule for derivatives?
cards.back: If y = u/v, then dy/dx = [v(du/dx) - u(dv/dx)] / v²

cards.front: What is the derivative of e^x?
cards.back: e^x - the derivative of e^x is itself

cards.front: What is the derivative of ln(x)?
cards.back: 1/x - the derivative of natural logarithm is 1/x

cards.front: What is the integral of e^x?
cards.back: e^x + C - the integral of e^x is itself plus a constant

cards.front: What is the derivative of x^n?
cards.back: nx^(n-1) - the power rule for derivatives

cards.front: What is the integral of x^n?
cards.back: x^(n+1)/(n+1) + C - the power rule for integrals (when n ≠ -1)

cards.front: What is the derivative of tan(x)?
cards.back: sec²(x) - the derivative of tangent is secant squared

cards.front: What is the derivative of sec(x)?
cards.back: sec(x)tan(x) - the derivative of secant

cards.front: What is the derivative of csc(x)?
cards.back: -csc(x)cot(x) - the derivative of cosecant

cards.front: What is the derivative of cot(x)?
cards.back: -csc²(x) - the derivative of cotangent is negative cosecant squared

cards.front: What is the integral of sin(x)?
cards.back: -cos(x) + C - the integral of sine is negative cosine

cards.front: What is the integral of cos(x)?
cards.back: sin(x) + C - the integral of cosine is sine

cards.front: What is the integral of sec²(x)?
cards.back: tan(x) + C - the integral of secant squared is tangent

cards.front: What is the derivative of arcsin(x)?
cards.back: 1/√(1-x²) - the derivative of inverse sine

cards.front: What is the derivative of arccos(x)?
cards.back: -1/√(1-x²) - the derivative of inverse cosine

cards.front: What is the derivative of arctan(x)?
cards.back: 1/(1+x²) - the derivative of inverse tangent

cards.front: What is the integral of 1/(1+x²)?
cards.back: arctan(x) + C - the integral of 1/(1+x²) is inverse tangent

cards.front: What is the integral of 1/√(1-x²)?
cards.back: arcsin(x) + C - the integral of 1/√(1-x²) is inverse sine

cards.front: What is the integral of -1/√(1-x²)?
cards.back: arccos(x) + C - the integral of -1/√(1-x²) is inverse cosine

cards.front: What is the derivative of a^x?
cards.back: a^x × ln(a) - the derivative of a to the power of x

cards.front: What is the derivative of log_a(x)?
cards.back: 1/(x × ln(a)) - the derivative of logarithm base a

cards.front: What is the integral of a^x?
cards.back: a^x/ln(a) + C - the integral of a to the power of x

cards.front: What is the derivative of sinh(x)?
cards.back: cosh(x) - the derivative of hyperbolic sine is hyperbolic cosine

cards.front: What is the derivative of cosh(x)?
cards.back: sinh(x) - the derivative of hyperbolic cosine is hyperbolic sine

cards.front: What is the derivative of tanh(x)?
cards.back: sech²(x) - the derivative of hyperbolic tangent is hyperbolic secant squared

cards.front: What is the integral of sinh(x)?
cards.back: cosh(x) + C - the integral of hyperbolic sine is hyperbolic cosine

cards.front: What is the integral of cosh(x)?
cards.back: sinh(x) + C - the integral of hyperbolic cosine is hyperbolic sine

cards.front: What is the derivative of |x|?
cards.back: x/|x| or sign(x) - the derivative of absolute value

cards.front: What is the integral of 1/√(x²-1)?
cards.back: ln|x + √(x²-1)| + C - the integral of 1/√(x²-1)

cards.front: What is the derivative of x^x?
cards.back: x^x(1 + ln(x)) - the derivative of x to the power of x

cards.front: What is the integral of 1/(x²+1)?
cards.back: arctan(x) + C - the integral of 1/(x²+1) is inverse tangent

cards.front: What is the derivative of √(x)?
cards.back: 1/(2√x) - the derivative of square root of x

cards.front: What is the integral of √(x)?
cards.back: (2/3)x^(3/2) + C - the integral of square root of x

cards.front: What is the derivative of 1/x?
cards.back: -1/x² - the derivative of 1/x is negative 1/x²

cards.front: What is the integral of 1/x²?
cards.back: -1/x + C - the integral of 1/x² is negative 1/x

cards.front: What is the derivative of x^(1/3)?
cards.back: (1/3)x^(-2/3) - the derivative of cube root of x

cards.front: What is the integral of x^(1/3)?
cards.back: (3/4)x^(4/3) + C - the integral of cube root of x

cards.front: What is the derivative of sin²(x)?
cards.back: 2sin(x)cos(x) or sin(2x) - the derivative of sine squared

cards.front: What is the derivative of cos²(x)?
cards.back: -2cos(x)sin(x) or -sin(2x) - the derivative of cosine squared

cards.front: What is the integral of sin²(x)?
cards.back: (x/2) - (sin(2x)/4) + C - the integral of sine squared

cards.front: What is the integral of cos²(x)?
cards.back: (x/2) + (sin(2x)/4) + C - the integral of cosine squared

cards.front: What is the derivative of e^(2x)?
cards.back: 2e^(2x) - the derivative of e to the power of 2x

cards.front: What is the integral of e^(2x)?
cards.back: (1/2)e^(2x) + C - the integral of e to the power of 2x

cards.front: What is the derivative of ln(2x)?
cards.back: 1/x - the derivative of natural logarithm of 2x

cards.front: What is the integral of 1/(2x)?
cards.back: (1/2)ln|x| + C - the integral of 1/(2x)

cards.front: What is the derivative of sin(3x)?
cards.back: 3cos(3x) - the derivative of sine of 3x

cards.front: What is the integral of cos(3x)?
cards.back: (1/3)sin(3x) + C - the integral of cosine of 3x

cards.front: What is the derivative of (x²+1)³?
cards.back: 3(x²+1)²(2x) or 6x(x²+1)² - using chain rule

cards.front: What is the integral of x(x²+1)²?
cards.back: (1/6)(x²+1)³ + C - using substitution

cards.front: What is the derivative of x²e^x?
cards.back: e^x(x²+2x) - using product rule

cards.front: What is the integral of xe^x?
cards.back: e^x(x-1) + C - using integration by parts

cards.front: What is the derivative of x³ln(x)?
cards.back: x²(3ln(x)+1) - using product rule

cards.front: What is the integral of x²ln(x)?
cards.back: (1/3)x³ln(x) - (1/9)x³ + C - using integration by parts

cards.front: What is the derivative of (x+1)/(x-1)?
cards.back: -2/(x-1)² - using quotient rule

cards.front: What is the integral of 1/(x²-1)?
cards.back: (1/2)ln|(x-1)/(x+1)| + C - using partial fractions

cards.front: What is the derivative of √(x²+1)?
cards.back: x/√(x²+1) - using chain rule

cards.front: What is the integral of x/√(x²+1)?
cards.back: √(x²+1) + C - using substitution

cards.front: What is the derivative of e^(x²)?
cards.back: 2xe^(x²) - using chain rule

cards.front: What is the integral of xe^(x²)?
cards.back: (1/2)e^(x²) + C - using substitution

cards.front: What is the derivative of ln(x²+1)?
cards.back: 2x/(x²+1) - using chain rule

cards.front: What is the integral of 2x/(x²+1)?
cards.back: ln(x²+1) + C - using substitution

cards.front: What is the derivative of sin(x²)?
cards.back: 2xcos(x²) - using chain rule

cards.front: What is the integral of xcos(x²)?
cards.back: (1/2)sin(x²) + C - using substitution

cards.front: What is the derivative of cos(x²)?
cards.back: -2xsin(x²) - using chain rule

cards.front: What is the integral of xsin(x²)?
cards.back: -(1/2)cos(x²) + C - using substitution

cards.front: What is the derivative of tan(x²)?
cards.back: 2xsec²(x²) - using chain rule

cards.front: What is the integral of xsec²(x²)?
cards.back: (1/2)tan(x²) + C - using substitution
